Meanwhile, Meta's Muse Glimmer has released open weights for a 30 billion parameter local coding model, potentially democratizing access to powerful AI tools for developers. On the creative front, a new voice-driven murder mystery game allows users to interrogate AI suspects, showcasing innovative applications of conversational AI. Additionally, Discovered Materials is leveraging AI to optimize semiconductor designs, addressing the industry's ongoing chip shortages. Finally, various startups are actively pursuing advancements in large language models (LLMs), indicating a competitive race that could lead to breakthroughs with significant commercial implications.
